basic_details.short_information: Institute of Himalayan Bioresource Technology (CSIR IHBT) Recruitment 2026: Institute of Himalayan Bioresource Technology has released the official notification for 3 Project Associate posts, inviting applications from eligible candidates. This recruitment provides an excellent opportunity for candidates seeking research jobs.

age_limit.age_details: Max 35 years for Project Associate PAT-I & PAT-II, Max 40 years for Senior PAT
age_limit.details: Project Associate PAT-I: Maximum 35 years (Age relaxation applicable for SC/ST/PwBD/Women by 05 years and for OBC by 03 years). Project Associate PAT-II: Maximum 35 years (Age relaxation applicable for SC/ST/PwBD/Women by 05 years and for OBC by 03 years). Senior PAT: Maximum 40 years (Age relaxation applicable for SC/ST/PwBD/Women by 05 years and for OBC by 03 years).

qualification.details: Project Associate PAT-I B.E/B.Tech in Computer Science/Information technology from a recognized university. MCA from a recognized university. Masters in Remote Sensing/GIS/Geoinformatics/AI & Data Science or an equivalent discipline from a recognized University. Desirable: Working Knowledge in AI/Machine Learning/Python programming/Drone image processing. Project Associate PAT-II B.E/B.Tech in Computer Science/Information Technology /Electronics (embedded programming) from a recognized University. Masters in Remote Sensing / GIS/Geoinformatics/ Geography/ Forestry/ Ecology/ Computer Science/ AI & Data Science or an equivalent in same discipline from a recognized University. 2 years' experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services. Desirable: two-years work experience in drone -based remote sensing/ hyperspectral remote sensing/artificial intelligence (AI). Senior PAT B.E./ B.Tech in Computer Science/ Information Technology/ Electronics (embedded programming) Masters in Remote Sensing/ GIS/ Geography/ Forestry/ Ecology/ Computer Science/ AI & Data Science or equivalent in same discipline from a recognized University. 3 years experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services. OR Doctoral degree in Computer Science/ Information Technology/ Electronics (embedded programming)/ Remote Sensing/ GIS/ Geoinformatics/ Geography/ AI & Data Science or equivalent in same discipline from a recognized University. AND 2 years experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services. Desirable: two-years work experience in drone -based remote sensing/ hyperspectral remote sensing/artificial intelligence (AI).

salary_details.details: Project Associate PAT-I: Rs. 31,000/- + HRA (for NET/GATE qualified candidates) or Rs. 25,000/- + HRA (for others) Project Associate PAT-II: Rs. 35,000/- + HRA (for NET/GATE qualified candidates) or Rs. 28,000/- + HRA (for others) Senior PAT: Rs. 42000/+HRA

selection_process: Scrutiny of applications by Screening Committees Interview over Video Conferencing/MS Team
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for CSIR IHBT Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 12-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for CSIR IHBT Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 12-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CSIR IHBT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the CSIR IHBT Recruitment 2026 is 12th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Associate posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for Project Associate positions, including Project Associate PAT-I, Project Associate PAT-II, and Senior PAT.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Associate PAT-I?
faq.answer: For Project Associate PAT-I, candidates need a B.E/B.Tech in Computer Science/Information Technology, MCA, or a Masters in Remote Sensing/GIS/Geoinformatics/AI & Data Science or equivalent.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any experience required for Project Associate PAT-II?
faq.answer: Yes, Project Associate PAT-II requires 2 years of experience in Research and Development in industrial, academic, or science and technology organizations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Senior PAT position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior PAT position is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Project Associate PAT-I?
faq.answer: The salary for Project Associate PAT-I is Rs. 31,000/- + HRA for NET/GATE qualified candidates, and Rs. 25,000/- + HRA for others.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to download the application form, fill it, scan it, and send it to the specified email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for CSIR IHBT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process involves the scrutiny of applications by Screening Committees, followed by an interview conducted over Video Conferencing or MS Teams.

faq.question: Q9. Does CSIR IHBT offer any age relaxation?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates (05 years) and OBC candidates (03 years).

faq.question: Q10. Where is CSIR IHBT located?
faq.answer: CSIR IHBT is located in Palampur, Himachal Pradesh, with a pincode of 176061.
